scope: All 1200 dataset1 JPEGs received visual contact-sheet screening. Flagged candidates were rechecked using larger source views and 60x80 aspect-preserving white-padded inputs.
reviewer: AI-assisted visual screening; original annotations and product identities were not independently authenticated.
limitations: Flags are provisional review decisions, not independently confirmed label errors.
No obvious issue is a screening result, not a guarantee of a correct label or an independent product.
Repeated products and related source photographs are not reliably detected by narrow perceptual-hash thresholds.
The source archive, bounding boxes, per-crop source-image IDs, and exact upstream version are missing.
This register applies only to the image and label hashes above; source changes require renewed review.
